name: Porlex Mini II
details: Compact hand grinder with ceramic conical burrs; clicks counted from zero.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 1–3, espresso 4–6, moka pot 7–11, AeroPress 6–16, V60 7–12, filter coffee machine 6–15, French press 12–22, cold brew 14–24. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
